12093-the-song-of-the-stone-wall.title: The Stone Wall
12093-the-song-of-the-stone-wall.creator: Helen Keller
12093-the-song-of-the-stone-wall.description: A book by Helen Keller. Thoughts like these were often in my mind as the poem grew and took form. It is fitting, therefore, that I should dedicate it to him, and in so doing I give expression to the love and reverence which I have felt for him ever since he called me his little cousin, more than twenty years ago.

arxiv-1710-06333.title: Curvature properties of the Vaidya metric
arxiv-1710-06333.creator: Absos Ali Shaikh 1 , Haradhan Kundu 1 and Jayashree Sen 1
arxiv-1710-06333.description: Abstract . As a generalization of the Schwarzschild solution, Vaidya presented a radiating metric to develop a model of the exterior of a star including its radiation field, named later Vaidya metric. The present paper deals with the investigation on the curvature properties of Vaidya metric.

arxiv-2112-11242.title: Unsupervised deep learning techniques for powdery mildew recognition based on multispectral imaging
arxiv-2112-11242.creator: Alessandro Benfenati
arxiv-2112-11242.description: Abstract Abstract Objectives Sustainable management of plant diseases is an open challenge which has relevant economic and environmental impact. Optimal strategies rely on human expertise for field scouting under favourable conditions to assess the current presence and extent of disease symptoms.

arxiv-2204-01887.title: Hybrid Probabilistic-Snowball Sampling Design
arxiv-2204-01887.creator: Giulio Giacomo Cantone, Venera Tomaselli
arxiv-2204-01887.description: Abstract Snowball sampling is the common name for sampling designs on human populations where respondents are requested to share the questionnaire among their social ties. With some exceptions, estimates from snowball samplings are considered biased. However, the magnitude of the bias is influenced by a combination of elements of the sampling design and features of the target population.

arxiv-2206-02512.title: Unsupervised TTS Acoustic Modeling for TTS with Conditional Disentangled Sequential VAE Thanks: Jiachen was an intern at Tencent AI Lab, Bellevue, WA. Equal contribution. Chunlei Zhang is the corresponding author.
arxiv-2206-02512.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a novel unsupervised text-to-speech acoustic model training scheme, named UTTS, which does not require text-audio pairs. UTTS is a multi-speaker speech synthesizer that supports zero-shot voice cloning, it is developed from a perspective of disentangled speech representation learning.

arxiv-2208-12498.title: A Low Dead Time, Resource efficient Encoding Method for FPGA based High-Resolution TDL TDCs
arxiv-2208-12498.creator: W.Dong, C. Feng, J. Wang, Z. Shen, S. Liu, and Q. An
arxiv-2208-12498.description: Abstract This paper presents a novel encoding method for fine time data of a tapped delay line (TDL) time-to-digital Converter (TDC). It is based on divide-and-conquer strategy, and has the advantage of significantly reducing logic resource utilization while retaining low dead-time performance. Furthermore, the problem of high bubble depth in advanced devices can be resolved with this method.

arxiv-2303-03339.title: Reducing Safety Interventions in Provably Safe Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2303-03339.creator: Jakob Thumm, Guillaume Pelat, Matthias Althoff
arxiv-2303-03339.description: Abstract Deep Reinforcement Learning (RL) has shown promise in addressing complex robotic challenges. In real-world applications, RL is often accompanied by failsafe controllers as a last resort to avoid catastrophic events. While necessary for safety, these interventions can result in undesirable behaviors, such as abrupt braking or aggressive steering.

arxiv-2403-19443.title: Mixed Preference Optimization: A Two-stage Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedbacks
arxiv-2403-19443.creator: Qi Gou, Cam-Tu Nguyen
arxiv-2403-19443.description: Abstract There are currently two main approaches to LLM alignment: online Reinforcement Learning (RLHF) with Proximal Preferene Optimization (PPO) and contrastive learning-based methods like Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). By analyzing advantages and disadvantages of PPO and DPO, we propose Mixed Preference Optimization (MPO) that mitigates some weaknesses of both approaches.

arxiv-2409-02179.title: Enhanced Dark Matter Abundance in First-Order Phase Transitions
arxiv-2409-02179.creator: Rouzbeh Allahverdi, Cash Hauptmann, Peisi Huang
arxiv-2409-02179.description: Abstract We propose a novel scenario to obtain the correct relic abundance for thermally under-produced dark matter. This scenario utilizes a strongly first-order phase transition at temperature T PT T_{\rm PT} that gives rise to dark matter mass m m .

arxiv-2410-01190.title: Integrating Visual and Textual Inputs for Searching Large-Scale Map Collections with CLIP
arxiv-2410-01190.creator: Jamie Mahowald, Benjamin Charles Germain Lee
arxiv-2410-01190.description: Abstract Despite the prevalence and historical importance of maps in digital collections, current methods of navigating and exploring map collections are largely restricted to catalog records and structured metadata. In this paper, we explore the potential for interactively searching large-scale map collections using natural language inputs (“maps with sea monsters”), visual inputs (i.e.

arxiv-2509-25410.title: Characterizing Event-themed Malicious Web Campaigns: A Case Study on War-themed Websites
arxiv-2509-25410.creator: Maraz Mia, Mir Mehedi A. Pritom, Tariqul Islam, Shouhuai Xu
arxiv-2509-25410.description: Abstract Cybercrimes such as online scams and fraud have become prevalent. Cybercriminals often abuse various global or regional events as themes of their fraudulent activities to breach user trust and attain a higher attack success rate. These attacks attempt to manipulate and deceive innocent people into interacting with meticulously crafted websites with malicious payloads, phishing, or fraudulent transactions.

arxiv-2510-08242.description: Abstract . Enabling users to create their own simulations offers a powerful way to study team dynamics and performance. We introduce VirT-Lab , a system that allows researchers and practitioners to design interactive, customizable simulations of team dynamics with LLM-based agents situated in 2D spatial environments.

arxiv-2602-08572.title: Precipitation induced recrystallisation (PIX) in a Ti-Fe-Mo bcc-superalloy driven by lattice misfit Journal: Journal & Under Review
arxiv-2602-08572.creator: Neal M Parkes, Kan Ma, Ben Poole, Chris Hardie, Alexander J Knowles
arxiv-2602-08572.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Neal M Parkes, Kan Ma, Ben Poole, Chris Hardie, Alexander J Knowles. Beta-Ti bcc-superalloys, comprising an A2 β \beta -Ti matrix reinforced by ordered intermetallic B2 β ′ \beta^{\prime} -TiFe precipitates, exhibit an unusual recrystallisation that occurs with no externally applied strain (i.e. no thermomechanical processing). Thermal ageing at 750 ∘ C for 72 h results in refinement of the grain size from 364 μ \mu m to 30 μ \mu m.

arxiv-2602-22499.title: Small HVAC Control Demonstrations in Larger Buildings Often Overestimate Savings
arxiv-2602-22499.creator: Arash J. Khabbazi, Kevin J. Kircher
arxiv-2602-22499.description: Abstract How much energy, money, and emissions can advanced control of heating and cooling equipment save in real buildings? To address this question, researchers sometimes control a small number of thermal zones within a larger multi-zone building, then report savings for the controlled zones only. That approach can overestimate savings by neglecting heat transfer between controlled zones and adjacent zones.

pmc-10531751.title: The Potential for Targeting AVIL and Other Actin-Binding Proteins in Rhabdomyosarcoma
pmc-10531751.creator: Robert Cornelison, Laine Marrah, Adelaide Fierti, Claire Piczak, Martyna Glowczyk, Anam Tajammal, Sarah Lynch, Hui Li, Wan Lee
pmc-10531751.description: Rhabdomyosarcoma (RMS) is the most common pediatric soft-tissue cancer with a survival rate below 27% for high-risk children despite aggressive multi-modal therapeutic interventions. After decades of research, no targeted therapies are currently available. Therapeutically targeting actin-binding proteins, although promising, has historically been challenging.

pmc-10567828.title: Methanogenesis in biogas reactors under inhibitory ammonia concentration requires community-wide tolerance
pmc-10567828.creator: Damien R Finn, Lena Rohe, Sascha Krause, Jabrayil Guliyev, Achim Loewen, Christoph C Tebbe
pmc-10567828.description: AbstractAmmonia (NH3) inhibition represents a major limitation to methane production during anaerobic digestion of organic material in biogas reactors. This process relies on co-operative metabolic interactions between diverse taxa at the community-scale. Despite this, most investigations have focused singularly on how methanogenic Archaea respond to NH3 stress.

pmc-10608862.title: Review of the Application of Dual Drug Delivery Nanotheranostic Agents in the Diagnosis and Treatment of Liver Cancer
pmc-10608862.creator: Qinghe Han, Lianze Du, Lili Zhu, Duo Yu, Keykavous Parang, Drazen Raucher
pmc-10608862.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Liver cancer has high incidence and mortality rates and its treatment generally requires the use of a combination treatment strategy. Therefore, the early detection and diagnosis of liver cancer is crucial to achieving the best treatment effect. In addition, it is imperative to explore multimodal combination therapy for liver cancer treatment and the synergistic effect of two liver cancer treatment drugs while preventing drug resistance and drug side effects to maximize the achievable therapeutic effect.

pmc-11331899.title: Identifying pain profiles in employees including work-related factors and pain perceptions: a cross-sectional study in Belgian companies
pmc-11331899.creator: Stijn Keyaerts, Lode Godderis, Vero Vanden Abeele, Liesbeth Daenen
pmc-11331899.description: ObjectivesStudies usually investigate a limited number or a predefined combinations of risk factors for sickness absence in employees with pain. We examined frequently occurring combinations across a wide range of work-related factors and pain perceptions.DesignCross-sectional study.SettingBelgian companies that are under supervision of IDEWE, an external service for prevention and protection at work.

pmc-11429460.title: Levels of Empathy in Students and Professors with Patients in a Faculty of Dentistry
pmc-11429460.creator: Víctor P Díaz-Narváez, Joyce Huberman-Casas, Jorge Andrés Nakouzi-Momares, Chris Alarcón-Ureta, Patricio Alberto Jaramillo-Cavieres, Maricarmen Espinoza-Retamal, Blanca Patricia Klahn-Acuña, Leonardo Epuyao-González, Gabriela Leiton Carvajal, Mariela Padilla, Lindsay W Vilca, Alejandro Reyes-Reyes,
pmc-11429460.description: Background: Empathy is an attribute that plays an essential role in the dentist–patient therapeutic relationship, clinical care, and treatment adherence, along with providing other benefits. The main objective of this research was to establish the validity, reliability, and invariance of the Jefferson Scale of Empathy and then characterize the empathy levels of students and teachers at a dental school.

pmc-11494183.title: Sleep restriction exacerbates cardiac dysfunction in diabetic mice by causing cardiomyocyte death and fibrosis through mitochondrial damage
pmc-11494183.creator: Jingyi Zhang, Xu Zhao, Jing Tang, Ce Liu, Yining Zhang, Cheng Cai, Qingfeng Du
pmc-11494183.description: Diabetic cardiomyopathy (DCM) is a cardiovascular complication of diabetes mellitus with a poor prognosis and is the leading cause of death in diabetic patients. Sleep deficiency is not only recognized as an important risk factor for the development of type 2 DM, but is also associated with increased morbidity and mortality of cardiovascular disease.

pmc-12550558.title: Challenges in the Management of Silent Lactotroph Pituitary Adenoma
pmc-12550558.creator: Melissa Hui Ting Leong, Yvette Li Yi Ang, Vincent Diong Weng Nga, Char Loo Tan, Jocelyn Yen Ling Wong, Doddabele Srinivasa Deepak
pmc-12550558.description: Silent lactotroph pituitary adenomas are rare tumors that clinically resemble nonfunctioning macroadenomas but are identified histologically by prolactin immunoreactivity. We report a 29-year-old woman with progressive visual loss caused by a large sella–suprasellar mass compressing the optic chiasm and invading the cavernous sinus. Initial endocrine evaluation was unremarkable, and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) suggested a nonfunctioning adenoma.

pmc-12638373.title: Genomic analysis highlights the conservation significance of Torenia concolor (Linderniaceae) from the periphery of its distribution range
pmc-12638373.creator: Yuji Isagi, Taiga Shimizu, Yukihiro Kobayashi, Yoshihisa Suyama, Chinatsu Tokuhiro, Goro Kokubugata, Takuro Ito, Kuo-Fang Chung, Atsushi Abe, Takashi Makino, Michimasa Yamasaki
pmc-12638373.description: Biodiversity status assessments are typically conducted on a regional basis. Consequently, there are numerous species that are rare in one region but ubiquitously present in another country or administrative region. Correctly assessing the conservation status and value of such “endangered species” is essential to achieve better biodiversity conservation through the appropriate and efficient use of socioeconomic resources.

pmc-12714075.title: Molecular Characterization and Genomic Diversity of SARS‐CoV‐2 Spike Gene Variants Circulating in Iraq: Mutational Impact on ACE2 Affinity, RBD Immune Escape, and Viral Transmission
pmc-12714075.creator: Anfal Mohammed Khudhair, Duaa Mohammed Abdulsatar, Sahar Taha Hatif, Dunya Jawad Ridha, Munim Radwan Ali, Jaafar Alsadiq Arkan Farhan Ali, Ahmed Majeed Al-Shammari
pmc-12714075.description: IntroductionThe spike (S) gene of SARS‐CoV‐2 is pivotal to the processes of cell entry, immune evasion, and the adaptation of the host.AimThis study aimed to comprehensively characterize the SARS‐CoV‐2 spike gene variants circulating in Iraq and assess the functional consequences of their mutations on ACE2 receptor affinity, RBD‐mediated immune escape, and viral transmissibility.

pmc-13560589.title: Treating depression in dialysis patients: pharmacological and non-pharmacological approaches
pmc-13560589.creator: Daniel Cukor, Christian Cornelius, Kate Dahl, Daniela Figueiredo, Helena Sousa, Ava Archey, Paul L Kimmel
pmc-13560589.description: Depression is relatively common in patients with kidney failure treated with hemodialysis, and the prevalence rate exceeds that of the general population. Depression should be treated in people maintained on dialysis, both due to depression’s inherent significance and its potential complications of kidney treatment. This paper reviews the relevant literature on reported pharmacological and non-pharmacological approaches.

pmc-13573426.title: Effect of empagliflozin with or without carvedilol on tricuspid regurgitation and right ventricular remodeling: PROVE trial
pmc-13573426.creator: Ga Yun Kim, So-Min Lim, Dong Hyun Yang, Jong Eun Lee, Sahmin Lee, Sung-Ji Park, In-Chang Hwang, Yeonyee Elizabeth Yoon, Chi Young Shim, Hyung-Kwan Kim, Sung-Cheol Yun, Jong-Min Song, Duk-Hyun Kang
pmc-13573426.description: BackgroundFunctional tricuspid regurgitation (TR) is associated with adverse outcomes. As TR, right ventricular (RV) remodeling, and worsening TR form a vicious cycle, therapies that reverse RV remodeling and reduce TR are needed. We examined whether sustained-release carvedilol (carvedilol SR), empagliflozin, or their combination reduces RV volumes and TR severity in patients with significant functional TR.

uslaw-usc-t39-s207.title: 39 U.S.C. § 207 — Seal
uslaw-usc-t39-s207.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t39-s207.description: United States Code, Title 39 (Postal Service); Part I (General); Chapter 2 (Organization). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The seal of the Postal Service shall be filed by the Board in the Office of the Secretary of State, judicially noticed, affixed to all commissions of officers of the Postal Service, and used to authenticate records of the Postal Service.

uslaw-usc-t46-s14503.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t46-s14503.description: United States Code, Title 46 (Shipping); Part J (Measurement Of Vessels); Chapter 145 (Regulatory Measurement); Subchapter I (General). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) The Secretary shall prescribe the certificate to be issued as evidence of a vessel’s measurement under this chapter. (b) The certificate shall be maintained as required by the Secretary.
